claim: The explicit179-entry cochain satisfies the cocycle and twisted-boundary identities and evaluates nontrivially on the displayed closed bar cycle. A uniform suffix formula for G satisfies pB=dG+Gd in all degrees, by a written proof from the finite boundary identity; direct tensor replay corroborates degrees0..4. The specified augmented seed complex over a characteristic-two field is exact iff q=0 or q has infinite multiplicative order; a nontrivial root of order d first fails in degree d-1, q=1 fails at the augmentation, and q=0 has two-dimensional Ext(s,C) in every degree at least two. This classification has a written coordinate proof and exact finite corroboration.

limitations: The remaining cone/stable-category machinery, full all-degree Ext vanishing, Tachikawa analogue and full counterexample remain outside scope; only the displayed seed-resolution parameter behavior is added here.
Python execution, implementations, source identification and the written relative-bar argument remain trusted.
Exact finite verification is not kernel verification, human peer review or a global novelty assessment.
At q=0 the nonzero evaluation conclusion fails; H must be invertible.

The new tensor implementation reuses the pinned predecessor algebra and polynomial arithmetic; it is not an independent algebra implementation. Finite degrees0..4 support, but do not replace, the written all-degree proof.
The parameter theorem is a written proof with exact finite-field corroboration, not a new Lean proof; generic sufficient exactness conditions already appear in source Lean.
At roots of unity the displayed complex is not a resolution: its Hom-complex cohomology must not be called Ext. No exclusion of alternative finite-field constructions.
